description: The data of a task event.

list_id.description: The id of the list that holds the task.

title.description: The title of the task. A deleted task has no title.

status.description: The status of the task, for example notStarted, inProgress, or completed.

importance.description: The importance of the task: low, normal, or high.

has_attachments.description: True when the task has one or more files.

due.description: The due date and time of the task, in the time zone of the task.

start.description: The start date and time of the task, in the time zone of the task.

reminder.description: The reminder date and time of the task. A task with no reminder on has no reminder.
